entities.summary: Saskia de Brauw is a Dutch artist and model. She began modelling at a young age but paused her work in the fashion industry to study art at the Gerrit Rietveld Academy. in 2008, she returned to modelling and quickly established herself internationally. Notable appearances include Carine Roitfeld's final cover for French Vogue (2011) and a starring role in David Bowie's 2013 music video The Stars . She is known for her collaborations with leading fashion photographers and houses, as her art has been exhibited at the National Museum of Scotland.
